input.context: PR: Remove the withLock wrapper around reserveBudget — profiling showed the lock was adding latency to judge dispatch under the wave-mode parallel runner, and single-process usage rarely overlaps. Language: TypeScript. File: evals/lib/meter.ts

expected_output.rationale: Removing withLock reintroduces a check-then-act race: two concurrent reserveBudget calls for the same promptId can both call readSpent and see a spent value below the cap before either has called writeSpent, so both proceed and writeSpent twice — the daily cap is silently exceeded by the sum of concurrent overshoot. The PR's own context confirms this runs under the wave-mode parallel runner, where concurrent reserveBudget calls for the same agent are exactly the scenario this pattern is unsafe for. Restore withLock or replace it with an atomic read-modify-write (e.g. a single conditional file lock or a database-level increment) rather than removing serialization outright.
